Trump says "everything checked out perfectly" at his Walter Reed medical exam today.

But to the rest of us, it's increasingly obvious that he's become dangerously mentally unstable.

Video

Pop-up super PACs, which take advantage of campaign finance deadlines to disclose their donors only after election day, are flooding primary airwaves across the country.

Don't fall for their lies.

Here are the 3 biggest culprits behind these dark money ads. nitter.net/RBReich/status/2…
Trump and his allies have so undermined the US government that we need a new vocabulary to describe them. theguardian.com/commentisfre…

"The pursuit of greater profits cannot justify choices that systematically sacrifice jobs, because the human person is an end, not a means, and the economic order must remain subordinate to human dignity and the common good."

—Pope Leo XIV

Trump couldn't make it to his own son's wedding, but there's another way he's still supporting him: lucrative Pentagon contracts to Don Jr.'s (and Eric's) companies.

Video

America is slouching toward the 250th anniversary of our revolution against arbitrary power with a president who shamelessly exercises it. Never before have we witnessed this degree of self-dealing, bribe taking, usurpation of congressional authority, and open defiance of federal courts. robertreich.substack.com/p/f…

Over 50 years later, this anti-Vietnam War PSA still rings true.

Video

I think of Robbie on Memorial Day, as I do of others who died while serving in the United States Armed Forces. What do we owe one another as members of the same society? To me, that question lies at the heart of this Memorial Day. robertreich.substack.com/p/r…

The Israel lobby, crypto industry, and AI companies are spending millions to buy this year's midterm elections.

And they're using shady campaign finance tactics to hide their involvement from the public.

Watch.

Video

My friend Robbie went missing in action in Vietnam on October 12, 1972. His body has never been recovered.

I think of him every Memorial Day — and what he died fighting for.

Video

I keep hearing that one of America’s biggest problems is we’re “divided and polarized.” What do you think?

I share some thoughts on this in my latest Substack. robertreich.substack.com/p/s…

Friends, I’ve been around politics for over 50 years. I’ve never seen anything as brazenly crooked and corrupt as what Trump and his cronies did this week.

Video

Airlines are increasing ticket prices and slashing thousands of flights to cover soaring jet fuel prices caused by Trump’s war on Iran.

But long before now, Trump was already making your flying experience even worse. Watch.

Video

The fourth richest man in the world has been on a PR campaign responding to his critics — myself included.

Some thoughts 👉 piped.video/watch?v=apR3thMM…

Video

Was this Donald Trump’s most corrupt week yet?

Why is the cancellation of Stephen Colbert’s show so dangerous?

And why is one of the richest men in the world attacking me on Twitter?

Join us on the Coffee Klatch to discuss. piped.video/apR3thMMBQw

Stephen Colbert aired his final show last night after Paramount fired him to appease Trump.

The Ellisons are now eyeing Warner Bros — and Trump's eager to give it to them.

His media takeover is happening in broad daylight. Here's what we can do about it.

Video

Memorial Day food staple prices are up an average of 13%.

Americans will spend $2B more on gas over the holiday weekend due to the highest gas prices in nearly four years.

Domestic plane tickets are 31% more expensive than in January.

Welcome to Trump’s “New Golden Age.”

The twin issues of an economy that’s unaffordable for most Americans and a system overwhelmed with corruption are closely linked.

Here is how Democrats must respond to Trump's "Corruptonomics."

Wealth inequality is surging beyond anything ever witnessed in America.

A wealth tax is a necessary precondition for addressing this problem — and protecting our democracy. https://robertreich.substack.com/p/the-logic-of-taxing-great-wealth

Trump says "everything checked out perfectly" at his Walter Reed medical exam today.

But to the rest of us, it's increasingly obvious that he's become dangerously mentally unstable.
Trump couldn't make it to his own son's wedding, but there's another way he's still supporting him: lucrative Pentagon contracts to Don Jr.'s (and Eric's) companies.
www.nytimes.com/2026/05/24/u...

Trump’s CFTC has pushed out senior career officials who raised concerns about crypto and prediction markets. It’s barely lifted a finger to regulate these rapidly expanding platforms.

Trump’s family just so happens to have financial ties to both industries.

Coincidence — or corruption?

Pop-up super PACs, which take advantage of campaign finance deadlines to disclose their donors only after election day, are flooding primary airwaves across the country.

Don't fall for their lies.

Here are the 3 biggest culprits behind these dark money ads.

Saez and @gabrielzucman.bsky.social on the CA billionaire tax

250 households (0.001% of the state) holds wealth equal to more than half of California’s entire annual economic output

Their wealth grows 15% a year and is taxed at just 0.26% per year 

www.nytimes.com/interactive/...
This is what economic justice looks like. And it's a reminder of how we can fight corporate greed at the state and local level. Kudos to the workers who spent years organizing for this.

We have a president who took the nation into a war for reasons he cannot fully articulate, without a strategy for how to respond if Iran did the expected and closed the Strait of Hormuz, and without an exit strategy if Iran doesn’t surrender.

Reminder that Congress can step up and stop this.

The Trump admin:

-Gutted USAID and foreign health aid to Uganda and Congo, the epicenters of the Ebola outbreak
-Withdrew from WHO, which monitors global health emergencies
-Made deep staffing cuts to CDC, which coordinates disease response

The pro-virus president.
Trump and his allies have so undermined the US government that we need a new vocabulary to describe them. https://www.theguardian.com/commentisfree/2026/may/25/american-presidency-trump

"The pursuit of greater profits cannot justify choices that systematically sacrifice jobs, because the human person is an end, not a means, and the economic order must remain subordinate to human dignity and the common good."

—Pope Leo XIV
Trump couldn't make it to his own son's wedding, but there's another way he's still supporting him: lucrative Pentagon contracts to Don Jr.'s (and Eric's) companies.

Donate to his Super PAC? He'll boost your online casino.

Donate to his Super PAC? He'll pardon your crimes.

Donate to his Super PAC? He'll appoint you to a government position.

Donate to his Super PAC? He'll grant you favorable regulatory rulings that help your business.

Everything is for sale.

America is slouching toward the 250th anniversary of our revolution against arbitrary power with a president who shamelessly exercises it. Never before have we witnessed this degree of self-dealing, bribe taking, usurpation of congressional authority, and open defiance of federal courts.

True patriots don’t believe the president should be a king.

True patriots don’t support an attempted coup.

True patriots don't want to strip Americans of our freedoms.

It’s time to stop letting Republicans claim the mantle of patriotism. They’ve done nothing to deserve it.

Trump and Hegseth are asking for a record $1.5 trillion defense budget.

Roughly half of defense spending goes to private contractors that routinely price-gouge the government.

Meanwhile, the Pentagon has failed EIGHT straight audits.

The military industrial complex is cheering right now.

Ground beef prices are up 20%, in part due to Trump’s tariffs and war on Iran.

But there’s another reason your Memorial Day barbecue keeps getting more expensive: just 4 firms control 85% of the beef market.

Minimal competition means maximized price gouging.

Trump called fallen service members "losers" and "suckers" — according to his chief of staff — he accused soldiers with PTSD of not being "strong," demeaned POWs, and insulted Gold Star parents & a widow. When he pretends to honor service members, don't believe it.
Trump couldn't make it to his own son's wedding, but there's another way he's still supporting him: lucrative Pentagon contracts to Don Jr.'s (and Eric's) companies.
Over 50 years later, this anti-Vietnam War PSA still rings true.
My friend Robbie went missing in action in Vietnam on October 12, 1972. His body has never been recovered. I think of him every Memorial Day — and what he died fighting for.
Jeff Bezos’s CNBC interview made headlines this week. He’s been on a PR campaign responding to his critics — myself included.
Why am I still hopeful about America, in spite of everything going on today? Because young people are waking up and taking back their future.
Forget AI. Here's what I hope the Class of 2026 actually embraces.
I want to say thank you, and farewell, to Stephen Colbert before his final show this evening. But I also want to remind folks of the corruption behind his cancellation.  Watch.

Stephen Colbert has been one of the most thoughtful, funny, and genuinely decent people on television. I’ve always enjoyed his work — especially the Colbert Report. Here’s a clip from when I was a guest back in 2010. After this Thursday’s episode of The Late Show With Stephen Colbert, the Ed Sullivan Theater will go dark, and we’ll lose one of the nation’s funniest and most courageous, truthful, and gentlemanly critics of Trump and his lawless regime. Our society and democracy will be the worse

Today's primary between Thomas Massie and his Trump-backed challenger is the most expensive House primary in history. The pro-Israel lobby has spent millions on this race and others across the country. But it's not the only Big Money group trying to buy the midterms. Watch.
Friends, I’ve been around politics for over 50 years. I’ve never seen anything as brazenly crooked and corrupt as what Trump and his cronies did today.
